import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']
s2_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 2].copy()

# Analyze S02 trips by fishing doy and class
s2_trips['yt_per_angler'] = s2_trips['yt'] / s2_trips['anglers']

# Group by doy and class
pattern = s2_trips.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'nunique'  # unique boats
}).reset_index()

pattern['yt_per_angler'] = pattern['yt'] / pattern['anglers']
pattern = pattern.sort_values('fish_date_doy')

# Key analysis: what happened in mid-year (where I fished) vs what's coming (Oct peak?)
print("S02 doy 100-182 (mid-season where I fished and held):")
mid_season = pattern[pattern['fish_date_doy'].between(100, 182)]
print(mid_season[['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler', 'boat']].tail(20))

# Look at overall S02 trend
print("\n\nS02 overall trend by doy:")
by_doy = s2_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'nunique'
}).reset_index()
by_doy['yt_per_angler'] = by_doy['yt'] / by_doy['anglers']
by_doy = by_doy.sort_values('fish_date_doy')

# Rolling average to see trend
by_doy['yt_per_angler_7d'] = by_doy['yt_per_angler'].rolling(window=7, center=True).mean()
print(by_doy[['fish_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler', 'yt_per_angler_7d']].tail(30).to_string())

# Compare class performance in S2 
print("\n\nS02 class performance (all doys):")
class_perf = s2_trips.groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
class_perf['yt_per_angler'] = class_perf['yt'] / class_perf['anglers']
class_perf = class_perf.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(class_perf[['cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']])
